tools.name: list_supported_chains
tools.description: List the BlockchainAnalysis MCP tools, the chains each supports, and pricing. Call this first to discover what the server can do (and which calls are free vs paid) before invoking a tool. Free.

tools.name: screen_address
tools.description: Screen a wallet against BlockchainAnalysis's 1B+ entity-label dataset: sanctions (OFAC / EU / UN / UK HMT / Swiss SECO), scam, phishing, exploit, mixer, exchange, and more — each label carries a threat level (SAFE→CRITICAL), source, and confidence. Works across major EVM chains plus TRON, SOL, and B

tools.name: kyt_risk
tools.description: Assess a wallet's KYT (Know-Your-Transaction) risk: sanctions + entity classification + VASP/jurisdiction score + cluster context → one risk verdict (critical / high / medium / low / unknown) with flags. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

tools.name: kyt_tx
tools.description: Transaction KYT: screens BOTH counterparties of a transfer (from → to) against sanctions + entity + VASP + cluster, returning a combined risk level, a block/review/allow recommendation, and directional FROM:/TO: flags. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

tools.name: oracle_verdict
tools.description: Consumer-protection verdict for a wallet or contract: a normalized verdict (safe / caution / high_risk) with a 0-100 score, confidence tier, and plain-language reasons. Answers 'is it safe to interact with this address?' Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

tools.name: screen_agent_wallet_attested
tools.description: Screen an agent wallet and return a SIGNED, on-chain-anchored compliance attestation: the verdict (clear / flagged / unknown) plus an EIP-712 (secp256k1) signature over the result and a BA Stamp anchor, so a third party or a smart contract can verify it offline via ecrecover without trusting us live
